content.text: THE MASTERSWhen is the 2026 Masters? Schedule for Masters at Augusta National Cameron JourdanGolfweekMarch 29, 2026, 11:00 a.m. ET0:32/0:45It's almost time for the first men's major championship of the year. The 2026 Masters is nearly here, as the best golfers in the world will head to Augusta National Golf Club to battle for the green jacket.When does the Masters start?
